'''Imperial Logistics''' was a division of the [[Sphere of Civil Administration]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Invasion of Manaan]] it was headed by [[Darth Norok]].<ref name="Legacy">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>
